player_quality_holdout.explanation: Only retrospective historical team-season rosters are presently available. The 1,831-game scoring-quality test has an untouched season but is NOT an as-of-preseason certified holdout.

required_for_player_quality_promotion: Obtain and timestamp 2023–24/2024–25/2025–26 rosters as captured before season opening; rebuild exactly the same 2024+2025 training / 2026 holdout without future roster membership; require improvement in both log loss and Brier, verify team identity and player feature parity, then consider releasing a calibrated scoring-quality model.
note: A real 1,831-game retrospective holdout was completed and improved both scores, but season rosters are retrospective and may contain look-ahead. Keep published 365-team roster-informed Elo provisional. No player-quality production promotion.
